subject: CloudSprint — partner credit handoff & activation logistics
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@cloudsprint.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Jacob Mills <jmills@cloudsprint.io>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: partner credit handoff for SI-led pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have a pilot opportunity with BrightLayer (their infra/dev team) and would like to route a partner-sponsored credit to cover 3 weeks of evaluation tokens + an optional one-week extension if needed.

Key ask: can Redwood allocate 40K trial tokens to CloudSprint so we can attach the credit to the BrightLayer proof-of-value (POV) under CloudSprint's partner account? Our legal and procurement want a one-line confirmation that credits will be redeemable for usage tied to the POV deal.

Attached: SOW-draft.pdf (partner POV outline), usage-projection.xlsx (estimate).

Timeline: kickoff next Monday (Sept 6) — we'd like credits in escrow by Friday to avoid delays.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Head of Partnerships | CloudSprint
O: +1 415 555 0192

-----Original Message-----
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Rao <anika@cloudsprint.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner credit handoff for SI-led pilot

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick answers up front:

- We can reserve a partner credit pool and mark it for "BrightLayer POV (CloudSprint)" so your team can redeem against the pilot.
- I need internal approvals for the exact token amount and escrow routing. Can you confirm the desired activation window and whether CloudSprint will manage the billing/commit (i.e., credits consumed under your partner account or billed to BrightLayer)?

Next steps from our side: I'm looping in Ben (sales ops) to clear the credit allocation and Marissa for partner financial sign-off. If you can cc your procurement/POC (Jacob already on thread), that'll speed approvals.

Proposed activation window: 2026-09-06 through 2026-09-27 (3 weeks), reserve one-week extension through 2026-10-04 if usage justifies it.

Olga Petrov
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Olga / team — reviewed. Finance is comfortable authorizing up to 45K tokens for this POV given the partner-driven pipeline and BrightLayer's strategic fit. Notes:

- Approve 40,000 base tokens + a 5,000 token optional extension (approve on request, no further paperwork if usage justifies).
- We will hold credits in a partner escrow pool tied to CloudSprint's partner ID. CloudSprint redeems; Redwood will provide token usage reports daily.
- Requirement: CloudSprint must ack terms (credits are promotional, non-refundable, expire 90 days after activation unless extension approved).

Action items:
1) Marissa: please prepare a short credit memo + one-line legal confirmation for CloudSprint procurement.
2) Jordan: coordinate the actual escrow routing and set up a usage dashboard share.

Ben Carter

Hi Olga / Ben — Jacob here from CloudSprint ops. We're good to accept the credits under our partner account and will provide an internal PO if you need it for audit. A couple of practical items from our side:

- Can Redwood confirm the token naming convention so we can map consumption in our internal billing? (e.g., REDWOOD_PARTNER_CLOUDSPRINT_BRIGHTLAYER_0906)
- We want the daily usage export to include: timestamp, customer org (BrightLayer), token delta, and remaining credit balance. Can that be shared via S3 link or secure dashboard?
- Please send the one-line confirmation Ben mentioned to jmills@cloudsprint.io and procurement@cloudsprint.io — we need it before we approve the internal kickoff.

Once we have the confirmation and the escrow is seeded, we'll proceed with an internal request to attach the credit to BrightLayer.

Thanks,
